content:
Creates a new profile. The type of profile created depends on the sensor_type  path parameter,
which can be set to either agent  or scanners .
Note: You can assign or remove an agent from an agent profile using the Assign or remove agent
profile endpoint. For scanners, use the Assign to scanner profile and Remove from scanner profile
endpoints.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string
Enum: "agent"
"scanners"
sensor_type
required
Content type
The type of sensor. Use agent  for agent profiles or scanners  for
scanner profiles.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
string
A name for the profile.
string
A short description explaining the purpose or targets of the profile.
Agent Profile Config (object) or Scanner Profile Config (object)
